fields.title: Parameter name
fields.description:
A unique name for the credentials input parameter. This name is exposed in the REST interface and in the
Call Workflow node. It must start with a letter, followed by letters and digits and single minus signs or
dashes and must end with a letter. Pattern: <tt>^[a-zA-Z](?:[-_]?[a-zA-Z0-9]+)*(?<![0-9])$</tt>

fields.title: Append unique ID to parameter name
fields.description: If checked, the name set above will be amended by the node's ID "{Parameter Name}-{Relative node ID}" to guarantee unique parameter names. Usually it's a good idea to have this box not checked and instead make sure to use meaningful and unique names in all container nodes present in a workflow.

fields.title: Description
fields.description: The description for the input parameter. It is currently not shown in the API specification of the REST interface but it's used for example when using this workflow as a tool for an AI Agent or when extracting the workflow summary.
